subject: POC Kickoff — Hands-on session: access, routing & load plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@ledgerlane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Kickoff — Hands-on session: access, routing & load plan

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for planning the POC with LedgerLane. To make the hands-on session useful for both teams, proposed plan below and a couple of logistics questions so we can lock the calendar: 

Proposed format (3 hours total)
- 09:30–10:00 Preflight & prompt review (share prompt corpus + expected outputs)
- 10:00–11:00 Deep dive: routing and prompt routing rules + KV cache walkthrough
- 11:00–12:00 Load validation & throughput tests (we’ll run synthetic traffic and a burst test)

Two scheduling options: onsite (Redwood team at your San Francisco office) or hybrid (Redwood remote join, LedgerLane attendees onsite). Dates we have open: Apr 22 or Apr 28 (both workdays). Please confirm preferred date and whether you want Redwood onsite. 

Logistics ask (please confirm):
- Final attendee list (names + emails) by Apr 15 so Marissa can secure visitor badges
- Any corporate firewall/nat egress rules that would block streaming audio/video or our test harness (we’ll provide IP ranges)
- Recording permission: do you permit the session to be recorded for internal playback? We can record only the Redwood screens if preferred.
- AV & screen sharing: for onsite, will we have a laptop with HDMI, or should we bring our own?

I attached a short preflight checklist and a visitor pass template to make approvals easier. If you prefer a dry-run (30 min) the week prior, we can schedule that too.

Thanks —

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments:
- preflight-checklist.pdf (1 page)
- visitor-pass-template.pdf (stub)
From: Alex Green <alex.green@ledgerlane.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@ledgerlane.com>, Security Team <security@ledgerlane.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff — Hands-on session: access, routing & load plan

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear plan. LedgerLane would prefer an onsite session on Apr 22 with 6 people from product and infra. A few quick items from our side: 

- Procurement wants a high-level cost/day for on-site eng support (we may need a nominal SOW) — procurement@ledgerlane.com is looped.
- Security would like a brief summary of data handling during the test and an excerpt of your SOC 2 controls. I attached the contact who will manage the questionnaire.
- We also need confirmation on whether Redwood will record the session and how recordings are stored (S3? access controls?).

Recording: LedgerLane is OK with a recording if Redwood can restrict access to named users and delete after 90 days.

I’ll compile the attendee list once you confirm visitor badge sponsor and room reservation. Apr 22 is preferred. Can you confirm a start time (we prefer morning)?

Alex Green
Head of Platform Integrations
LedgerLane
alex.green@ledgerlane.com | +1 212-555-0147

[Forwarded attachment: security@ledgerlane.com - security contact]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Alex Green <alex.green@ledgerlane.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff — Hands-on session: access, routing & load plan

Ben / Alex —

I can take point on onsite logistics. I’ll reserve Conference Room A-12 for Apr 22, 09:30–12:30 and submit a badge sponsor request today. Please send final attendee names by Apr 15 so I can complete the visitor list. 

AV notes: A-12 has HDMI and a Logitech conference camera; if Redwood prefers to bring a laptop that mirrors to HDMI we’re good. For recording, we can either:
- Use the room camera + system (we’ll need written consent from LedgerLane), or
- Redwood can record locally and we’ll host in secure S3 with limited IAM roles.

I attached the room reservation confirmation (stub). I’ll also loop our facilities manager if we need dedicated network ports for the load generator.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments:

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff — Hands-on session: access, routing & load plan

Alex / team —

Great, Apr 22 morning is locked on our side. We’ll plan to start at 09:30 PT as Marissa reserved. Notes/follow-ups: 

- Recording: we’ll do a Redwood-screen-only recording. We will store the recording in our S3 bucket with restricted access and agree to the 90-day retention and deletion request. I’ll send the S3 path and the access list after the session.
- Prework: I’ll share a preflight folder (prompts + small test corpus) by Apr 12. Please ask your infra lead to whitelist the IP ranges in the preflight checklist.
- Dry-run: we suggest a 30-minute dry-run on Apr 15 at 11:00 PT to validate screen sharing and the load generator connectivity. Please confirm availability.

Calendar invite (placeholder): https://calendar.redwood-inference.com/event/pocevent-20270422

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com | +1 415-555-0198
